name: 28492-longdecode-qwen332bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, bounded at 1024 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, Faker-generated English. Prompt exactly 256 tokens and output exactly 512 (min = max), `request_format: plain`, `temperature: 0.0`; `ignore_eos` is forced whenever max_tokens is set, so every reply is exactly 512 tokens.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant for 32-billion-parameter writing tasks, serving 32 concurrent users short prompts on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048

# Pinned deliberately, not copies of a default -- do not drop them as redundant.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256

enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
